title: ADC Resolution Explorer: Command-Line Tool
description: ADC Resolution Explorer built as a Command-line tool. An N-bit ADC splits its reference voltage into 2^N steps, so each LSB equals Vref / 2^N and any reading carries up to half an LSB of quantization error. Doubling the bit depth halves the step size, which is why a 12-bit converter resolves signals four times finer than a 10-bit one. A subcommand CLI that generates seeded synthetic topic rows and reports summaries, top-N rows, or filtered rows as tables or JSON.
